before_conditions: A stake can be withdrawn and then cancelled multiple times
Each cancellation records an amount into _cancelledWithdrawalAmount
The manager role can call redelegateWithdrawnHYPE() to redelegate withdrawn HYPE that was previously cancelled
required_property: The _cancelledWithdrawalAmount variable should accurately reflect the actual cancelled amount (including fees) so that redelegateWithdrawnHYPE() does not revert and can redelegate the correct amount
bad_outcome: address(this).balance becomes less than _cancelledWithdrawalAmount, causing redelegateWithdrawnHYPE() to revert
